0022600190.text: The Nets (2-6, 1-3 on the road, 5th in the Atlantic) visit the Hawks (6-4, 1st in the Southeast), who enter on a three-game winning streak, while Brooklyn is on a one-game win streak after losing six of its last eight. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (out, leg bruise) and Noah Clowney (day-to-day, illness, game-time decision), while Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Nets lost all four matchups last season, most recently 141-107 in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
